seo.defaultDescription: Book your room straight with the house: best rate, free cancellation, a real person to talk to.

meta.title: HotelCore — book your room direct
meta.description: Book your room straight with the house: best rate, free cancellation, a real person to talk to.

hero.title: A room that is already made up for you.
hero.lede: No middlemen, no hidden fees. You book where the breakfast is made.

bestRate.title: Best rate
bestRate.body: The price here is the price at the desk — no third-party commission.

flexible.title: Free cancellation
flexible.body: Plans change. The terms are stated before you book, not in the small print.

contact.title: One point of contact
contact.body: Requests about arrival or the room go straight to reception.

search.title: Available rooms
search.lede: Choose your dates and party; prices are shown for those exact nights.
search.cityTaxNote: All prices already include the city tax of {{amount}} per person and night.

meta.title: Available rooms — HotelCore
meta.description: Availability and current prices for your dates.

form.label: Search rooms
form.priceNote: All prices include VAT and every mandatory charge.

errors.missingDates: Please enter a check-in and a check-out date.
errors.pastDate: Check-in cannot be in the past.
errors.order: Check-out must be after check-in — at least one night.

prompt.title: Choose your dates
prompt.body: Prices and availability depend on the dates. Please enter check-in and check-out.

empty.title: Nothing is free for these dates
empty.body: Try different dates or a smaller party. The reason for each room type is listed below.

reason.CapacityExceeded: Too small for this party — please reduce the number of guests.
reason.MinNightsNotMet: Minimum stay not reached — please extend your dates.

offer.freeCancellation: Free cancellation until the stated time.
offer.restrictedCancellation: Limited cancellation — terms shown in the next step.

roomType.title: Room in detail
roomType.lede: Facilities, occupancy and prices for this room type.
roomType.fromPriceNote: Starting price per night without dates. The total price is shown once you enter your dates.

meta.title: Room — HotelCore
meta.description: Facilities, occupancy and current prices for this room type.

price.cityTaxNote: The city tax is part of the total price and is not charged if the stay does not take place.
price.cityTaxChildExemption: Children under {{age}} are exempt from the city tax.
price.dueAtProperty: Payable at the property on arrival: {{amount}}

order.totalNoteVatAndMandatory: Including VAT and every mandatory charge. Nothing else will be added.
order.paymentAtProperty: The amount of {{amount}} is payable at the property on arrival.
order.reconfirmBody: The price or the terms were updated while you were filling in the form. By law we may only book what was actually shown to you. Please review the new summary and confirm again.

contract.OnConfirmationEmail: The contract is concluded with the confirmation e-mail.
contract.OnHotelAcceptance: Your request is passed to the house; the contract is concluded only once the house accepts it.

hold.hint: We are holding this room for you. When the time runs out the room is released and the price is calculated again.
hold.expiredHint: The hold has expired. You can request a new offer.
hold.expiredBody: The room has been released. We can check the same dates again — availability and price will be worked out afresh.
hold.abandon: Cancel this booking and release the room
hold.priceChangedBody: Previously {{previous}}, now {{current}}. Please check the summary before continuing.

a11y.remaining: {{minutes}} minutes and {{seconds}} seconds left on the hold
a11y.announceFiveMinutes: Five minutes left before the hold expires.
a11y.announceOneMinute: One minute left before the hold expires.
a11y.announceExpired: The hold has expired. You can request a new offer.

guest.title: Your details
guest.emailHint: We send the confirmation and the link to your booking to this address.
guest.minimizationNote: That is all we ask for. Date of birth, nationality and ID details are collected on arrival for the registration form, not now.

stay.title: About your stay
stay.arrivalHint: Optional — helps reception if you arrive late.
stay.noteHint: Optional, 500 characters at most. Please do not include health data or other sensitive details.

invoice.title: Invoice address
invoice.toggle: I need an invoice for a company or to a different address.

payment.title: Payment
payment.PayAtProperty: Payment on arrival at the property.
payment.noCardNote: We never ask for card details on this site — not now and not later.

consents.title: Confirmations
consents.withdrawal: I have read the notice about the right of withdrawal.
consents.adult: I am at least 18 years old.
consents.marketing: I would like to receive occasional offers from the house by e-mail. (Optional, can be withdrawn at any time.)

cancellation.label: Cancellation
cancellation.lateFee: After that {{percent}} % of the accommodation amount is charged — currently {{amount}}.
cancellation.cityTaxNote: The city tax does not arise on cancellation and is not part of the cancellation fee.

noHold.title: No room is being held
noHold.body: This step needs a room and a set of dates. Please start from the search.

confirmation.title: We have your booking
confirmation.emailTitle: The confirmation is on its way
confirmation.emailBody: We have sent the booking confirmation with all details to {{recipient}}. It contains the contract terms in durable form.
confirmation.linkNote: Keep the link from the e-mail: it opens your booking at any time, without an account and without a password.

meta.title: Manage booking — HotelCore
meta.description: View your booking, request access or cancel.

lookup.title: Access your booking
lookup.lede: Enter your booking reference and e-mail address. We will send the access link again.
lookup.referenceHint: Twelve characters, as in the confirmation: XXXX-XXXX-XXXX
lookup.sentBody: If a booking matches these details, we have sent the access link to that e-mail address.
lookup.privacyNote: For data protection reasons we do not confirm here whether a booking exists. The answer is always the same.

cancel.title: Cancellation
cancel.free: This cancellation is free of charge. Nothing will be charged.
cancel.feeDue: A fee of {{amount}} applies to this cancellation.
cancel.cityTaxNote: Only the accommodation amount is used as the basis; the city tax does not arise.
cancel.acknowledge: I understand that {{amount}} will be charged.
cancel.reasonHint: Optional — helpful for the house, but not required.
cancel.offlineBody: This stay can no longer be cancelled through the site. Please contact the house directly.

cancelled.title: This booking is cancelled
cancelled.body: A cancellation confirmation has been sent to your e-mail address.

consent.label: Cookies and tracking
consent.title: Only with your consent
consent.body: We would like to understand how this site is used. That needs your consent — without it nothing is loaded and nothing is stored.
consent.essential: Strictly necessary and allowed without consent: your language choice and the room hold in progress. Without them a booking cannot be completed.

legal.pending: The binding text is maintained by the house.

adr.participating: The house takes part in dispute resolution proceedings before a consumer arbitration board.
adr.notParticipating: The house is neither obliged nor willing to take part in dispute resolution proceedings before a consumer arbitration board.

withdrawal.label: Right of withdrawal
withdrawal.cancellationHint: This does not affect the contractual cancellation terms: you may cancel your booking under the conditions stated above.

excluded.title: No right of withdrawal
excluded.accommodation: Accommodation contracts for a specific date carry no 14-day right of withdrawal (Widerrufsrecht). The exclusion follows directly from the law.

included.title: Right of withdrawal
included.body: You have the right to withdraw from this contract within fourteen days without giving any reason.

privacy.label: Privacy
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: Information about the processing of personal data.

errors.email: Please enter a valid e-mail address.
errors.consentRequired: Without this confirmation we cannot complete the booking.
errors.adultRequired: Bookings are only possible from the age of 18.
errors.feeAcknowledgeRequired: Please confirm the amount before cancelling.

footer.about: A house that lets its own rooms — and welcomes its own guests.
footer.priceNote: All prices include VAT and mandatory charges.

notFound.title: This page does not exist
notFound.lede: It may have moved. Everything can be reached again from the home page.

public.label: Notice
public.title: That did not work
public.validationFailed: Some entries could not be accepted. Please check the highlighted fields.
public.cardDataNotAccepted: Card details are never processed on this site. Please contact the house.
public.channelNotConfigured: This payment method is not set up for this house. Please contact the house.
public.hotelNotFound: This house is not taking online bookings at the moment.
public.roomTypeNotFound: This room type no longer exists. The current rooms are listed in the overview.
public.holdNotFound: Your hold is no longer there. We can check the same dates again.
public.bookingNotFound: We cannot find a booking for this link. It may have expired.
public.holdExpired: The hold has run out and the room has been released. Request a new offer — price and availability will be worked out afresh.
public.holdAlreadyUsed: This hold has already been turned into a booking. Please check your inbox.
public.roomNoLongerAvailable: The last room of this type has just been taken. Please choose from the current results.
public.capacityExceeded: This room type is too small for that number of guests. Please reduce the party size.
public.summaryChanged: The price or the terms changed while you were filling in your details. We may only book what was actually shown to you — please review the new summary and confirm again.
public.legalTextChanged: The terms or the privacy notice have been updated. Please review the new version and confirm again.
public.cancellationNotAllowed: This booking can no longer be cancelled online. Please contact the house directly.
public.feeAcknowledgementRequired: The cancellation fee has changed. Please check the current amount and confirm it again.
public.bookingAlreadyCancelled: This booking has already been cancelled.
public.rateLimitExceeded: Too many requests came from this connection. Please try again shortly.
public.paymentProviderUnavailable: Payment processing is unavailable right now. Please try again later.
public.network: We could not reach the house. Please check your connection.
public.conflict: Something changed in the meantime. Please reload the details.
public.server: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
public.unknown: That did not work. Please try again.
